videos.title: How Burger King’s New Whopper Is Winning Back Customers | WSJ
videos.description:
Burger King is trying to convince America it has the best burger out—and that it’s worth paying for. The No. 2 U.S. burger chain by sales has charged its corporate chef with upgrading the sauces, buns and packaging for its food. Executives believe the improvements are helping it to stand out in the competitive fast-food market that often relies on discounts to bring in customers. But they are also having to convince restaurant operators that the changes are worth the investment even at a time when food costs are rising.

WSJ goes inside Burger King’s test kitchen at the company’s Miami headquarters and speaks with executives about how they’re seeking to gain more sales through juicier chicken nuggets and hotter Whoppers.

videos.description:
Delaware County, Pennsylvania, and Maricopa County, Arizona, have adopted policies addressing employee prediction market activity. Officials say the rules are meant to prevent financial conflicts, protect workers from allegations and reassure voters, not respond to evidence that election workers have used the markets. CNBC's Ananya Chetia reports on how prediction markets are prompting new safeguards and raising questions about nonpublic information and voter trust.

videos.title: How Meta Will Enforce New Age And Time Limits On Instagram And Facebook
videos.description:
Meta has agreed to pay up to $17 billion and make sweeping changes to Instagram and Facebook as part of a landmark child safety settlement with nearly every U.S. state. The deal introduces new protections for teens, including time limits, overnight blocks and stronger age verification, changes that could fundamentally alter how young people use Meta’s platforms. But implementing those safeguards, particularly determining users’ ages, presents major technical and business challenges. يمكنك الوصول إلى الأدوات والإرشادات والتنبيهات على منصة البنك الدولي الخاصة بالموردين: http://wrld.bg/YG1v50Z4Ul7 من خلال منصة مجموعة البنك الدولي للموردين، تستطيع الشركات من جميع الأحجام الحصول على تمويل بمليارات الدولارات لمشاريع عالمية. يشرح هذا الفيديو كيفية إيجاد فرص التوريد، والتعامل مع منهجية التوريد المُحدَّثة، والمنافسة بنزاهة على العقود في مجالات السلع والأعمال والخدمات. مع أكثر من 1600 مشروع نشط في أكثر من 100 دولة، تشمل المشتريات الممولة من البنك الدولي ما يلي: الأعمال المدنية والمعدات أنظمة تكنولوجيا المعلومات والاستشارات خدمات فنية متخصصة للشركات الصغيرة والمتوسطة والشركات العالمية ما الجديد في هذا الإطار المُحدَّث؟ يركز النظام الجديد على أفضل قيمة (وليس مجرد أفضل سعر)، والمشاركة المبكرة في السوق، وخيارات دفع أفضل، ونظام شكاوى قوي لضمان عملية اختيار عادلة وشفافة. تعرّف على المزيد وسجّل عملك اليوم: http://wrld.bg/YG1v50Z4Ul7

videos.title: Will AI Make or Take the Next Billion Jobs? | The Development Podcast
videos.description:
How will artificial intelligence reshape the future of work—and will it create enough opportunities for the next generation? 

Over the next decade, 1.2 billion young people are expected to enter the workforce, but only around 400 million jobs are currently projected to be available. In this episode, host Tanvir Gill explores whether AI could help close that gap—or make the challenge even greater. Entrepreneur and content creator, Marina Mogilko, explains how workers can build an advantage through AI systems, agents and “vibe coding.” Mohamed Eissa, IFC Chief Investment Officer and Global Head of Venture Capital and Direct Technology Investments, examines how AI could transform businesses and create opportunities across emerging markets. Sharat Raghavan, Director of Data Science and Research at LinkedIn, shares what their data reveals about changing jobs, rising skills and the future of career progression.
